_readme: S407 SkyMesquite, 2026-10-17. Its registry row names the college's schedules-and-catalog page (pdf_by_section); the census never named a catalog file. This read lists the page's catalog and PDF links (shown, not followed) so a session can tell which file or host holds the 2026-2027 catalog before any capture. One load, no model call.

questions.catalog_address: Every link the catalog page shows to a catalog or a PDF: its words and address, and which is the 2026-2027 catalog.
